EMPLOYMENT AGREEMENT

This Employment Agreement is made between Vertex Analytics India Private Limited ("the Company") and the Employee, who joins as a Data Analyst reporting to the Head of Analytics.

1. Term and Duties
1.1 The Employee is appointed on a permanent basis and shall perform the duties of a Data Analyst and such other duties as the Company may assign.

2. Compensation
2.1 The Employee's annual cost to company is Rs. 11,00,000, which includes basic salary, house rent allowance and a performance bonus.

3. Intellectual Property
3.1 All inventions, software, work product and deliverables created by the Employee, whether or not during working hours and whether or not using Company resources, shall belong exclusively to the Company.

4. Non-Competition
4.1 For a period of two (2) years after the termination of employment for any reason, the Employee shall not, directly or indirectly, join, advise or start any business that competes with the Company in India or abroad.

5. Non-Solicitation
5.1 For twelve (12) months after leaving, the Employee shall not solicit or entice away any client or employee of the Company.

6. Termination
6.1 The Company may terminate this Agreement at its sole discretion without assigning any reason.
6.2 The Employee shall give sixty (60) days notice of resignation.

7. Leave
7.1 The Employee is entitled to twenty (20) days of paid leave per year.

8. Disputes
8.1 Any dispute shall be resolved by arbitration in Mumbai by an arbitrator appointed by the Company.
